title: ArticlesHandoff
description: Output of the Scraper Agent containing parsed articles from verified news sources.

published_at.description: ISO 8601 or RFC 2822 published timestamp (null if missing from source)

text_summary.description: Extracted article body or summary text

full_text.description: Cleaned extracted full text, capped at 6000 chars. INTERNAL ONLY for Editor Agent, never published.

word_count.description: Word count of the extracted full text

scraped_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when article was scraped

age_hours.description: Age of the article in hours relative to scrape reference time
